sources.title: GitHub - LehaoFu/dynamic: EchoNet-Dynamic is a deep learning model for ...
sources.snippet: The input of EchoNet-Dynamic is an apical-4-chamber view echocardiogram video of any length. The easiest way to run our code is to use videos from our dataset, but we also provide a Jupyter Notebook, ConvertDICOMToAVI.ipynb, to convert DICOM files to AVI files used for input to EchoNet-Dynamic.

sources.snippet: The EchoNet-Dynamic database includes 10,030 labeled echocardiogram videos and human expert annotations (measurements, tracings, and calculations) to provide a baseline to study cardiac motion and chamber sizes.

sources.title: EF Training and Evaluation | echonet/dynamic | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the training and evaluation process for the Ejection Fraction (EF) prediction models in EchoNet-Dynamic. It covers the entire training pipeline, evaluation methodology, and performance analysis for deep learning models that predict cardiac ejection fraction from echocardiogram videos. For information about the specific video model architectures, see Video Model Architecture.
